ai_summary: Astra Microwave Products Limited reported modest Q1 FY27 revenue and profitability due to temporary customer approval delays, but boasts a record INR 4,300 crore order book, significantly boosted by a recent INR 2,205 crore Uttam Radar contract from HAL. The company projects robust full-year growth of 15-20% and an ambitious multi-year order pipeline, alongside plans to spin off its Space and Weather divisions into a separate listed entity. However, management explicitly highlighted potential red flags, acknowledging significant execution challenges and supply chain risks inherent in fulfilling these extensive new orders.
